Package chess.model

Class Position

java.lang.Object
chess.model.Position
public final class Position extends Object
A square on the chess board, stored as an array row and column.

Coordinate mapping: row 0 is rank 8 and row 7 is rank 1; column 0 is file A and column 7 is file H. For example, E2 is row 6, column 4.

Positions are immutable and always on the board: the constructor rejects any row or column outside 0–7.

    • fromNotation

      public static Position fromNotation(String notation)
      Creates a position from chess notation such as "E2". Letters may be upper- or lowercase, and surrounding spaces are ignored.
      Parameters:
      notation - a file letter A–H followed by a rank digit 1–8
      Returns:
      the matching position
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the text is not a valid square

      public static boolean isOnBoard(int row, int col)

      row - the array row to check
      col - the array column to check
      Returns:
      true if both are between 0 and 7

    • offset

      public Position offset(int rowChange, int colChange)
      Returns the position shifted by the given amounts, if it stays on the board. Pieces use this to look at neighboring squares.
      Parameters:
      rowChange - the number of rows to move (negative is toward rank 8)
      colChange - the number of columns to move (negative is toward file A)
      Returns:
      the new position, or null if it would be off the board
